content.short: Based on our "Connect2Earn" approach, users are rewarded with tokens if they connect with others in real-life.
content.description: In today's world, there is a lack of real-life interactions between people. People are only connected virtually and online, but not in real life. But people need real experiences and feelings, it's in our nature. SmartPlaces Protocol introduces a new era of socializing. With our 'Connect2Earn' approach users can easily earn token rewards by engaging in social activities in real-life situations while having fun.
